markscheme.html:
8a

Most alpha particles passed through the foil undeflected; however a small percentage of the alpha particles was deflected through large angles.

This suggested that the positively charged alpha particles were deflected due to the concentration of positive charge in a small volume.

In turn, this led the scientists to conclude that the atom is mostly empty space with a small, dense, positively charged nucleus.

8b

A beam of white light is passed through a gas.

Photons in the light beam with energies that correspond to the difference between energy levels in the atom are absorbed by electrons in the atom (and as a result, the electrons become excited).

The light that emerges from the gas is passed through a prism and projected onto a screen, where an absorption spectrum is formed (with black lines at the position of the absorbed photons).
